dedupe_keys.name: lignes equipees de liaison radio sol train

description: Lignes équipées de liaison radio sol-train is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Lignes du Réseau Ferré National équipées de liaison sol-train. Ce fichier liste les portions de ligne équipées de liaison radio sol-train et en précise le type. La liaison peut être sans transmission de données (SANS TD), avec transmission (AVEC TD) ou GSM. Coverage: France. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Réseau. Its keywords are SNCF RESEAU, Lignes, Infrastructure, Radio sol-train, Géolocalisation. The portal shows 2022-03-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
